notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/vadter__hantek6022be --backend fake --verbose: G1 to G9 passed and the run printed no findings or warnings. Evidence is contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level. The hardware backend (native.py) was never imported, started or tried; no hardware run is claimed.

What the package covers: resource state sample_rate (get_rate, Hz), ch1_vdiv and ch2_vdiv (ChVDiv entries, V per division), and one acquisition summary computed from the upstream GetData (sample_count, duration_s, and minimum, maximum and RMS voltage of each channel); cap.device.configure.v1 writes for sample_rate, ch1_vdiv and ch2_vdiv, each read back from the native; the e-stop and teardown() call the upstream close(), which resets the USB device and disposes its resources (pyhantek6022BE.py:494-506). Limits: sample_rate is Limit(allowed=...) with the eight keys of dictN_SR (100 kS/s, 200 kS/s, 500 kS/s, 1 MS/s, 4 MS/s, 8 MS/s, 16 MS/s, 48 MS/s; pyhantek6022BE.py:83-85) and each vertical division is Limit(allowed=...) with the four keys of dictN_VDiv (1, 0.5, 0.2, 0.1 V/div; pyhantek6022BE.py:77-78). No operator bound is needed, so site-limits.example.json was not written. The upstream get_rates() list (50 kHz, 250 kHz, 500 kHz, 2 MHz, 4 MHz, 8 MHz, 24 MHz; pyhantek6022BE.py:235-240) is not the accepted samplerate set, so the driver reads get_rate() and writes set_samplerate() instead of trusting that list.

NOT COVERED: the waveform array. GetData() returns one voltage array per channel of buf_len = dictDatLen_N[samplerate] // 2 samples: 131072 samples per channel at the default 16 MS/s and 1048576 at 48 MS/s (pyhantek6022BE.py:91-97, 162-174). No catalogue class carries an oscilloscope trace, so this package does not transfer the samples; it reports the scalar measurements of the acquisition and the settings. The fake returns 512 samples per channel as placeholder test data (marked in fake.py); 512 is not a Fact, a Limit or a reference. The fake's close() marks the fake closed but keeps the last acquisition available so the post-e-stop state read can be served; a real released device would not answer.

DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card names the PythonObjectDriver helper. This package is a direct decorated Driver over pyhantek6022BE:Hantek because the upstream is a hardware-owning synchronous object with a native stop (close) and the writes need the cap.device.configure.v1 state bindings with allowed sets; the card's decision field is direct-driver. The card also lists cap.sensing.read.v1, but its resource_kinds are sensor, sensor.imu and sensor.force_torque, not an instrument, so the reads are served as resource state and no catalogue action is declared. No extension ids are used, so there are no catalogue requests.

The clone's LICENSE file contains only 'Bible Matthew 10:8.' and states no licence grant (LICENSE:1); the card and driver.lock.json pin license_spdx NOASSERTION with license_class unknown. The package is model-authored (authored_by kind model, model_id deepseek-v4.1-flash:1017, run_id wP-035) and unreviewed (reviewed_by null); no human reviewed or tested it.
